notes.title: Home Behind: Spring Festival Update and New DLC preview
notes.notes:
Happy New Years to every Home Behind fans!
The Year of the Dog is coming!

We appreciate all your love and support. Coconut Island Studio and TPP Studio will work together to make this game even better.
So, please receive our New Year gift -- 

Before Spring Festival(Chinese New Year),
we will update a new package, 
AND! A payable DLC with brand new contents!

Preview of Spring Festival update
1. A new difficulty level
2. New Collection System, can be used to strength the character
3. Special Tools about Spring Festival

Preview of NEW DLC
1. A New Game Mode. The travel will be much more harder...
2. New selectable jobs. (Available in any modes)

We'll reveal more details in the futere.
Cheers to a new year and wish you happy holidays.

notes.title: New Update: Children in the War
notes.notes:
制作人ZPP语

“战乱连连的地区，受到最深伤害的往往都是最为无辜的儿童，但人们对于他们的悲惨遭遇并不是非常了解。我们在研究了动荡地区的儿童状况后，决定在新版本中添加“娃娃兵”这个元素。乍一看可能会觉得非常不人道，但我们的确是怀着悲悯的心情选择了这个元素的，因为我们觉得，没有什么能够比用仇恨跟冷血挤占掉儿童本来该有的天真无邪更让人心痛的事情了。

虽然无力改变现状，但我们依然在游戏中尽量呈现出了我们希望发生的现实。很难说这次的更新内容会让你们喜欢，但希望能够借此让战乱地区的儿童获得更多的关注。”

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25238209/349a67bbff3661174eda8663748e7675a988a8bb.jpg

时隔多日，归家异途总算迎来了本次的更新内容，讲述在战争中儿童的故事，在玩家归家的旅途中，不仅仅是主角失散了女儿，在战争中，许多的儿童都在经历着悲惨的生活，面对他们，你会怎么做呢！

本次更新的主要内容
1.新增一段完整的分支剧情，你将在旅程中面临全新的威胁，以往的技巧是否还能有用呢？
2.增加一种新敌人，也许是敌人吧：儿童兵以及新地点：训练营
3.添加剧情相关的信件和笔记，以展现更多细节

希望你们继续喜欢本游戏。

notes.title: New Update: Children in the War
notes.notes:
A Letter from the developer, ZPP
“Innocent children are the biggest victims of wars, but people barely understand their painful experience. We decided to add new contents for those “Child soldiers”, after we researched their miserable conditions in war zones. 

Some players may think it’s cruel, but we did make these contents with grief and sympathy from the bottom of our heart. There’s nothing more inhuman than depriving children’s innocent and pure. 

Although we don’t have the power to change their situation, we still want to express our expectations in the game. It’s hard to say: please enjoy it. But we do hope that more and more people will pay attention to those kids in war zones.”

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25238209/349a67bbff3661174eda8663748e7675a988a8bb.jpg

It takes months, and we finally complete the new content of Home Behind! It tells a story about the children in the war zones. During the war, our main character is not the only one who lost everything. Hundreds of kids are suffering, and what would you do if you were there?

Contents of new update:
1. A new storyline. You’ll face new threats. 
2. New type of ‘enemy’(maybe) : Child Soldiers. And a new map: Training Battalion.
3. Letters and notes related to the story. Showing more details of facts.

Hope you’ll continue loving our game.

notes.title: V1.134c Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Patch Notes 



- Optimized visual effects and game performance

- Modified ending scene

- Fixed fighting effects and time

- Fixed art and text

- Fixed various small BUGs

- Balanced HP of the enemies and game mechanics

- Added Russian language





---------- Human Language ----------



Common Update: enhanced detalization and game performance for better gaming experience

Rare Update: tuned overall game balance and random generated game elements

Epic Update: Modified game ending, now it explains what is going on

Legendary Update: Well... maybe not this time. We were waiting for so long, and now we can share this news with you guys. We were planning to release DLC for the game, where the story continues. But, when ZPP started working on game changes, they added so many changes, which is enough for new game. So, after long meeting, we decided to start work on new game instead of short DLC. The story of the new game will about one character from Home Behind. 



PS: Mobile version of the game already finished and will be available soon for iOS and a bit later for Android!

PPS: If after upgrade of the game you will see black screen, upgrade your graphics card drivers.
